title: Lessee Can't Be Forced To Pay Installments Accruing Due To State's Delay In Termination Of Mining Lease: Allahabad High Court
description: The Allahabad High Court has held that where a mining lessee defaults in paying royalty and thereby gives the State ground to terminate the lease, the State's unexplained delay in exercising its power to determine the lease under Rule 58 of the U.P. Minor Minerals (Concession) Rules, 1963 amounts to arbitrary action. It held that the lessee cannot be forced to pay the installments that fell due only because of delay on part of the State. Rule 58(1) of the Rules, 1963 empowers the State Governmen
